description: Source code for ue_link_adaptation_controller class, implementing link adaptation logic for user equipment in a wireless communication system, including MCS calculation, OLLA adjustments, and CQI/SNR management.

classes.name: ue_link_adaptation_controller
classes.description: Manages link adaptation for a UE, including MCS calculations, CQI/SNR adjustments, and OLLA updates.

methods.name: handle_dl_ack_info
methods.description: Handles downlink ACK info, updates OLLA and MCS limits based on ACK/NACK.

methods.name: handle_ul_crc_info
methods.description: Handles uplink CRC info, updates OLLA and MCS limits based on CRC results.

methods.name: get_effective_cqi
methods.description: Calculates effective CQI considering outer loop adjustments.

methods.name: get_effective_snr
methods.description: Calculates effective SNR including UL OLLA offset.

methods.name: calculate_dl_mcs
methods.description: Derives downlink MCS based on CQI and link adaptation.

methods.name: calculate_ul_mcs
methods.description: Derives uplink MCS based on SNR and link adaptation.

methods.name: update_dl_mcs_lims
methods.description: Updates downlink MCS limits based on current MCS table.

methods.name: update_ul_mcs_lims
methods.description: Updates uplink MCS limits based on current MCS table and transform precoder setting.
